items.title: Do Dead Malls Have Game?
items.author: Aliza Abidi
items.content: Two Dallas sports franchises could give new purpose to two aging shopping malls. But first they’ll have to clear some hurdles.

items.title: Not All Decades Are Created Equal: Rethinking the Texas Land Market Time Series
items.author: Aliza Abidi
items.content: Nearly six decades of Texas land market data reveal shifting relationships between prices and sales volume. A closer look at large and small land markets challenges how we think about forecasting.

items.title: The Illusion of Abundance: Record Home Equity’s Purchasing-Power Problem
items.author: Aliza Abidi
items.content: Since last fall, real property values have been declining at an annual rate of approximately 4 percent in Texas and 2 percent nationally.
